usage: The word '半小時' functions as a noun and represents the duration of thirty minutes.
It can be used to specify how long an activity takes or when something will happen, like '我等咗半小時' (I waited for half an hour).
'半小時' can be combined with verbs and numbers to describe time lengths in conversation.
You can use '半小時' in past, present, or future tense contexts by pairing it with appropriate time verbs.
It often appears with time expressions or periods to describe short durations.
